_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the ABL season cache (key abl_schedule_2026, as BaseABLManager._fetch_abl_api_data builds it in November 2026) with ABL games converted from test/fixtures/abl_schedule.json: two finals, a seven-inning final and two scheduled games. The live screen can't be fed from the cache (_fetch_todays_games asks the Stats API every poll), so test_mode makes the live manager draw its Brisbane-at-Sydney test game.
